entries.de19cfcc379083ed: The company has adopted as its management philosophy "Become a company that provides more 'happiness and joy' to more people," and states that, with "Technology x Creativity" as its slogan, as a technology-oriented company it aims to be a global company. It states that through its two businesses — the cloud solutions business, which supports improvement of companies' management efficiency, and the marketing solutions business, which can execute client companies' marketing strategies — it will continue to support the development of customer companies. In its company-wide strategy, it makes three points — "business," "human resources" and "environment" — important issues, and states that it will work on solving social issues through business, recruitment, development and retention of human resources and promotion of diversity, and reduction of greenhouse gas emissions.
